[[Duke/Legends|Duke]] '''Erron Irbian''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|human]] who was officially in charge of the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Jorra]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia]]. He was loyal to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. After the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], he enforced harsh labor conditions on factories that produced [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeders]], [[Droid/Legends|droids]], and [[Starship/Legends|starships]] for the Empire.
